d:
Struggling with trapped gas, bloating, indigestion, or stubborn constipation? In today's yoga session, I guide you through a gentle yet effective yoga pose sequence designed to provide instant relief from digestive discomfort and IBS symptoms.
These targeted poses help massage the internal organs and stimulate the digestive tract to provide instant relief from trapped gas, bloating, and indigestion, and help things move naturally.
In this video, you'll learn:
• Specific poses to release trapped gas.
• Gentle movements to alleviate bloating and indigestion.
